that puts a private, zero-trust gateway in front of DSH Web. One all"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"owlist.

enough to get in."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Getting started"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"You need a working local DSH Web profile and Node.js 20+ (normally supplied by
DSH). Installing the "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"plugin does nothing until you run setup. Nothing is
exposed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Install**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Set up**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Setup opens a menu, previews a plan, and waits for you to confirm. It refuses
public or anonymous de"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"faults. Operators on Tailscale.com are steered to
identity-aware Tailscale Serve."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then restart the DSH Web process you already own, and open the configured HTTPS
origin as an allowli"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"sted principal. Port 3088 itself remains unreachable from
the LAN and from the provider network."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The full command is `dsh-one-gateway`; `dsh-gateway` is a shorter alias.
Cloudflare Access, Headscal"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e, local checkouts, and unattended flags are in
Setup in detail."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"An exact principal allowlist in front of DSH, a loopback-only HTTP/WebSocket
proxy, and a single onb"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"oarding command that previews a plan and refuses public
or anonymous defaults."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The gateway and DSH stay on loopback. Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Tunnel with
Cloudflare Access, or "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"Headscale via Tailscale TCP Serve is only the private
ingress. Joining that private network is **nev"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"er** an authorization decision.
Every request must resolve one unambiguous, allowlisted principal be"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"fore
anything is forwarded to DSH. That is self-hosted access control for a zero
trust homelab: reac"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"hability is not permission."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Callers authenticate through Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, or — on
Headscale — a generated gat"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"eway credential in front of private TCP Serve."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How this is different"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Other DSH gateways may bind off loopback, patch DSH internals so a gate stays
exhaustive after upgra"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"des, or run a reverse proxy in front of DSH. Those
designs can cover `/api` and WebSockets too; the "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"difference is not who covers
more of the surface. This plugin is a different contract: DSH itself ne"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ver
leaves loopback."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **Private network membership is never authorization.** Binding `0.0.0.0` or
treating RFC1918 as a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"n allow is out of scope. The listener stays on loopback.
Being on the same Wi-Fi, tailnet, or mesh d"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"oes not get you in.
2. **Fail-closed DSH origin.** DSH stays on loopback; the gateway is the only
li"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"stener in front of it. A DSH upgrade cannot silently add a route that
becomes reachable off-host — t"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"here is no gate route table to keep
exhaustive, because DSH was never reachable off-host to begin wi"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"th. A missed
route in a full-coverage gate is a silent bypass; a missed route in this
bridge just br"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"eaks that one proxied path. It does not expose DSH.
3. **No DSH-core or client-library patches.** So"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"me gates stay exhaustive by
patching DSH HTTP and upgrade entry points, then re-applying those patch"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"es
after every upgrade — because an upstream change can silently undo them.
This gateway is an exter"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"nal process. DSH's own code is never modified.
4. **For Tailscale Serve and Cloudflare Access, ident"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"ity comes from the
provider — not a login page, password, or shared token.**
Password forms, shared "},{"id":"p22s12","text":"tokens, and session-cookie doors are a large auth
surface and a common source of bugs. Those two shi"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"pped modes use Serve's
injected `Tailscale-User-Login`, or a locally verified Cloudflare Access
JWT."},{"id":"p22s14","text":" We check an allowlist. We do not ask you to invent a password.
`gateway-credential` is a smaller, p"},{"id":"p22s15","text":"urpose-built login for transports with
no native identity: a generated per-principal credential (not"},{"id":"p22s16","text":" a user-chosen
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What this plugin does not do"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Make DSH itself multi-tenant, or reduce the privileges of an allowlisted user
(every allowlisted p"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rincipal is a full DSH administrator).
- Treat device, node, or mesh membership as human identity.
-"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" Expose a configurable generic reverse proxy or an arbitrary trusted-header
name.
- Support public a"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nonymous tunnels, Funnel, or Cloudflare quick tunnels.
- Manage provider-wide ACLs, DNS zones, or ac"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"count policies.
- Auto-remove persistent provider routes on uninstall.
- Accept user-chosen password"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"s.
- Run more than one ingress provider in one gateway instance.
- Protect you from a malicious same"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"-host administrator or any process that can
already read DSH memory/configuration or connect directl"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"r or any process that can
already read DSH memory/configuration or connect directly to DSH loopback."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What each auth mode proves"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"These `auth.mode` values are the literal YAML keys. Each one is paired with a
fixed provider; you ca"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"de` values are the literal YAML keys. Each one is paired with a
fixed provider; you cannot mix them."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **`trusted-header` (Tailscale only).** Serve injected exactly one
`Tailscale-User-Login` and the v"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"alue is on the allowlist as
`login:<exact-login>`. The header name is fixed in code. You cannot conf"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"igure
a generic header.
- **`signed-jwt` (Cloudflare Access only).** The request carried exactly one"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"
`Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion` that verifies against the team JWKS, with the
configured issuer and appli"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"cation audience, required `exp`/`iat`/`nbf`,
identity `type`, scalar `email`, and non-empty `sub`. T"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"he allowlist uses
`email:<exact-email>`. The `CF_Authorization` cookie is never trusted.
- **`gatewa"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"y-credential` (Headscale TCP Serve).**
Possession of a distinct ≥256-bit credential issued per opera"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"tor (CLI-
generated, not a user-chosen password), submitted in a POST body from the
JSON API or a sa"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"me-origin login form — never a URL query parameter — and
exchanged for a short-lived `__Host-` sessi"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"on cookie (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`,
`SameSite=Strict`). The gateway stores only a verifier hash; sessio"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"ns are
individually revocable and attempts are rate-limited without permanent
lockout. TCP Serve doe"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"s not contribute identity: being able to reach the
node is not authorization. Tailscale Serve and Cl"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"oudflare Access cannot
select this mode."}],"truncated":true}
